notes: Evidence spans three checks: 5 October (0.1.78-3795b4c), 8 October (0.1.78-636f3f5) and 13 October (0.1.78-c1fa197, the installed build). Later checks supersede earlier ones: the 5 October 'Check' section's claims that Tabs accepts only children, modes, scrollable and style (no testID), that JFSThemeProvider has no effect, that non-scrollable tabs get equal width (flex: 1), and that every tab is its own Tab stop are all stale; the facts now declare accessibilityLabel and testID, and the 13 October check confirms hugging tabs, ellipsis, and a single Tab stop. Facts versus evidence: the package doc says modes are forwarded to every TabItem child, but the evidence says only direct TabItem children are recognised (wrappers and fragments are not); the configuration rule keeps the evidence's narrower reading. Examples pass modes on Tabs only, because the facts say Tabs forwards them to its TabItem children. Selected tab and Underline are marked not required: the package does not enforce a selection (TabItem active defaults to false, and an all-idle row is possible); the guide's 'exactly one selected' is a configuration rule. Guide problems: the Sources note has a stray capital after a semicolon ('…whether it is selected; Only the selected tab is in the Tab order'); Sizing opens with 'Tabs stretches to the width of its container' while the tabs themselves hug their labels (not a contradiction, but easy to misread as equal-width tabs, which the 5 October evidence measured). The Dark mode gap (#197) was last recorded on 5 October and is not mentioned in the guide copy, which shows Light only.

configuration.text: Pass the tabs as TabItem children: children is required, and each child should be a TabItem.
Put each TabItem directly inside Tabs: Tabs passes its modes to direct TabItem children, and does not recognise wrappers or fragments around them.

from.quote: Wrappers and Fragments around TabItems are not recognised.

configuration.text: Set modes on Tabs: they are forwarded to its direct TabItem children (not through wrappers or Fragments), and a TabItem's own modes win.
Turn on scrollable when the labels don’t fit, so the row scrolls sideways.

from.quote: Turn on scrollable when the labels don’t fit, so the row scrolls sideways.

configuration.text: Do not squeeze a long set, such as six filters, into a row that doesn’t scroll: every label shrinks and ends in an ellipsis, even “All”.

from.quote: Every label shrinks and ends in an ellipsis, even “All”.

configuration.text: Keep track of the selected tab on the screen: mark that TabItem active, and move the mark when another tab is pressed.
